content.text:
Here is a summary of the search results. Most of it comes from third-party guides. The only Anthropic source that came up was an engineering blog post, and the official authoring docs didn't appear. Check the size targets and the third-person advice against Anthropic's docs before you rely on them.

**Structure**
- A skill is a folder with a `SKILL.md`. It has YAML frontmatter (`name`, `description`) followed by markdown instructions.
- Personal skills go in `~/.claude/skills/`. Project skills go in the repo's `.claude/skills/`, where version control can share them.
- Scripts, templates, and reference docs can sit beside `SKILL.md`. These are optional.

**Description**
- The description is the most important field, because Claude uses it to decide whether to trigger the skill. Spend most of your effort there.
- Include the trigger keywords and situations that should activate it. A vague description can mean the skill never fires automatically, so test that it does.
- Community advice is to write it in the third person, since it gets injected into the system prompt.

**Progressive disclosure** (Anthropic's stated core principle)
- Only the name and description load at startup, so you can install many skills without filling the context window.
- The full `SKILL.md` loads only when the skill looks relevant.
- Linked files load on demand.

**Keep it lean**
- Put only what every use needs in the main body. Community guides suggest staying under about 500 lines.
- Move scenario-specific material into reference files. In `SKILL.md`, say when to read each one.
- Keep references one level deep, with no chains of files pointing to other files.

**Justify the skill**
- Check whether Claude already handles the task well without a skill. Write one only for real gaps.

Sources:
- [How to create a Claude Code skill (and the best practices nobody put in the docs)](https://codemeetai.substack.com/p/how-to-create-a-claude-code-skill)
- [Lessons from building Claude Code: How we use skills](https://claude.com/blog/lessons-from-building-claude-code-how-we-use-skills)
- [How to Write Skills for Claude Code and Cowork](https://sherlock.xyz/post/how-to-write-skills-for-claude-code-and-cowork)
- [skill writing (skills.sh)](https://www.skills.sh/meriley/claude-code-skills/skill-writing)
- [Equipping agents for the real world with Agent Skills (Anthropic Engineering)](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/equipping-agents-for-the-real-world-with-agent-skills)
- [Production-grade agent skills authoring guide 2026](https://noqta.tn/en/blog/production-grade-agent-skills-authoring-guide-2026)
- [Writing and reviewing agent skills: common pitfalls](https://smcleod.net/2026/07/writing-and-reviewing-agent-skills-common-pitfalls/)
